text: A user may reserve a resource only for a project on which the user is listed as an authorized member. Reservations must identify the authenticated user and the authorized project.
Independent operation of the laser cutter requires a current laser_safety qualification.
Independent operation of the tensile tester requires a current lab_safety qualification.
Independent operation of the robotic workcell requires a current robotics_level_2 qualification.
Use beginning before 08:00 or ending after 18:00 requires an approved after_hours authorization covering the requested interval.
A resource must have current calibration and must not be in maintenance mode before a reservation is created.
A reservation request must identify one resource, a project, and an unambiguous start and end time. If any field is missing, request clarification before attempting a reservation.
